taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from MI2.1-8 | Immunology: Basic, Applied & Immunological Disorders.

words.clue: Any substance that can be specifically recognised by lymphocytes or antibodies
Specific region of an antigen recognised by an antibody or T-cell receptor
Y-shaped glycoprotein produced by plasma cells in response to antigen
Non-specific immunity that acts within minutes to hours and is present from birth
Type of immunity acquired through exposure that generates immunological memory
White blood cell that mediates the adaptive immune response, includes B and T types
Small molecule that is antigenic but requires coupling to a carrier protein to become immunogenic
Antigen capable of inducing a specific immune response
Signaling molecule such as IL-12 or TNF-α that activates the adaptive response
Phagocytic cell of innate immunity that engulfs and destroys pathogens
System of proteins in innate immunity that functions as part of the first line of defence
